title: [$175] Export to-do omits reports that Search returns for `action:export`
body:
## Problem The Export to-do in App can show fewer reports than `Search` returns for `action:export`. On one test account, `Search` returned 4 reports (8 expenses) and the Export to-do showed 0. All 4 reports were approved and paid, belonged to an admin, sat on a workspace with an accounting integration, and had not been exported or hit an export error. Two rule differences cause the gap: 1. **Exporter check.** The to-do rule requires `policy.exporter === login` ([TodosUtils.ts](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/901155d74da8954c96aada81b94f0c1e4415ceac/src/libs/TodosUtils.ts#L167-L170)). On QuickBooks workspaces, `policy.exporter` can be empty while the connection's exporter is the user. `isPreferredExporter` in `PolicyUtils.ts` already reads the connection exporters. 2. **Auto-sync.** With auto-sync on, `isExportAction` decides no manual export is needed, and the report page agrees. The backend still returns these reports for `action:export`. App also decides "should this user export this report" in four places that don't agree: - Home to-do count - Search sidebar item and badge (Awaiting export) - Search row action and report page primary action - Report page secondary action (More menu) ## Expected result Use one export rule in all four places in App, and make it match the backend's `action:export` results. ## Unit tests The fix must include thorough unit tests for the shared export rule. Cover at least: - `policy.exporter` set to the user, set to someone else, and empty - Connection exporter set to the user while `policy.exporter` is empty, for each supported accounting integration - Auto-sync on and off - Reports already exported, and reports with an export error - Admin and non-admin users - Each of the four places above returning the same result for the same report ## Steps to reproduce 1. Sign in as a workspace admin on a workspace with QuickBooks connected. 2. Set yourself as the exporter in the QuickBooks export settings, and leave `policy.exporter` empty. 3. Approve and pay a report without exporting it. Test once with auto-sync on and once with it off. 4. Open the Export to-do and compare it with the `count` in the `Search` response for `action:export`. ## Related - #91559 _Reported in [Slack](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/C08CZDJFJ77/p1788794653229289)._
